reviewed.by: PENDING — ROUND 1 COMPLETE 2026-08-03 (argument + orthodoxy + neutrality, all three NOT STAMPABLE; 0 HERESY). Every finding applied; the corrected text is new un-gated content and all three re-run. WHAT ROUND 1 CAUGHT, because these are the traps on this argument: (a) ALL THREE lenses flagged the closing card. 'A Jesus who does what only God can do' was refuted by the reel's own scene 5 — Elijah and Elisha raised the dead (1 Kgs 17:22, 2 Kgs 4:34-35) and Moses commanded the sea, so a skeptic closes the reel on its last frame with one verse. Scene 10 had already bounded the claim to forgiving-and-judging; the close silently widened it back over the miracle cards. House precedent found by the argument gate: the certified sibling reel did-jesus-claim-to-be-god.json runs 'HE DID WHAT ONLY GOD DOES' over forgiveness and worship ONLY, never nature miracles. Now 'who claims what belongs to God alone.' (b) BOTH DOCTRINAL LENSES flagged the hook. 'John is the last Gospel written. SO let's use the first one' made lateness the stated REASON for setting John aside — the developmental thesis in miniature, conceded in our own voice in the opening seven seconds. The argument gate dissented and read it as strategic; on a doctrinal question dual consensus governs. Orthodoxy supplied the timing arithmetic that settles it: the John fence at scene 12 began at 87.4s of a 105.8s LOOPING reel, so the modal viewer (enters sc.3, drops at sc.9) met neither it nor the 'Mark never writes Jesus is God' admission. A fence 83% of the way in is not a fence. The fix puts scene 12's first four words on scene 1 — 'Not because John is doubtful. Because you don't need him.' — so scene 12 became payoff rather than rescue. (c) ORTHODOXY AND ARGUMENT BOTH caught that scene 7 truncated Mark 14:62 at 'the right hand of Power', dropping 'and coming with the clouds of heaven' — the half jesus_claims.html:156 calls DECISIVE in our own voice and retired-claims.json calls 'the stronger half of the case'. Two costs: doctrinally, 'seated at the right hand' standing alone unfenced is the phrasing most readily read as an exalted deputy — the two-powers reading — and the essay carries a live orthonote on that exact phrase which a reel cannot host, so the clause IS the fence; and logically, scene 10's 'judging from heaven' had no warrant on any card, since enthronement is session, not judgment. Restored. (d) ALL THREE flagged scene 9's 'hostile testimony — his enemies telling us'. The argument gate's catch is the sharpest: THIS SITE USES THAT TERM TO MEAN INDEPENDENT NON-CHRISTIAN CORROBORATION (ev-s3.html:98), so a reader who met it on our own pages hears us claiming Sanhedrin-side sources, which we do not have. It also left the spec's own fence 7 (assert only what Mark NARRATES) and stated unconditionally what jesus_claims.html:156 states conditionally, since the night trial's historicity is disputed. Rescoped to 'Both times, the charge comes from his accusers — not from his followers,' which keeps the full force of the criterion inside the narrative. (e) Scene 11 said 'Mark gives us both' three cards after 'Mark never writes Jesus is God' — self-contradiction in a loop, the near-invariant mastery-page failure CLAUDE.md logs — plus a theopaschite risk with 'dead on a cross' one line above 'Fully God'. Now 'One person. Mark holds on to both.' (f) 'only God could claim that' dropped the essay's own qualifier at :178, 'only God could RIGHTLY claim' — without it the sentence is literally false, since anyone can claim anything and the point is entitlement. (g) Citation defects: scene 5 cited the storm and Jairus's daughter but not the demons it asserted (5:8 added); scene 11 carried NO citation on the one card whose whole force is 'the same Gospel' (4:38, 11:12, 15:37 added); scene 3 cited Mark 1:2-3 while saying 'Isaiah's line', pointing at the exact composite quotation used to argue Mark misattributes his sources (now Mark 1:3 · Isaiah 40:3). (h) Read times raised on scenes 1, 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 12, 13 — the argument gate's table showed nine cards at or above 2.8 w/s BEFORE counting kicker and citation lines, which is adequate, not the generous the owner asked for. 105.8s → 116.3s. THREE THINGS ALL THREE LENSES TOLD ME TO PRESERVE: scene 10's 'Mark never writes Jesus is God. He doesn't have to' (pre-empts the one-verse takedown; called the best card in the reel by two lenses); scene 4's 'The scribes, sitting there, THINK' (Mark 2:6 says 'questioning in their hearts', and compression normally loses this); and scene 11's Chalcedon card, which orthodoxy said 'should be copied to other deity reels' since it closes the standing corpus gap. NEW BUILD 2026-08-03. Deity tier: needs apologia-argument + apologia-orthodoxy + apologia-neutrality (dual consensus is the two doctrinal lenses, NOT the whole bar). Cards-only, no voiceover field, so every hedge and bound must live on a card — there is no second surface. SOURCES: library/jesus_claims.html (the Mark 2 / Mark 14 spine, the 'earliest Gospel' wording, and the bracketing-John orthonote at :174), library/jesus_as_god_nt.html (:175-177 honest-scope paragraphs), docs/book-research/did-jesus-really-say-he-was-god.md (Del Rosario: the two blasphemy scenes as the structure; ch.12's 'authority over sacred things, nature, demons, disease, death'; the implicit-claim point that Jesus did not need the words 'I am God'). BUILT-IN FENCES — each one is a known trap on this argument: (1) THE THEME MUST NOT IMPLY JOHN IS UNHISTORICAL. Del Rosario calibration flag 6: Mark-not-John is a STRATEGIC choice — meeting the skeptic on his own ground — never a concession that John is late-and-therefore-doubtful. Scene 12 carries this and must not be cut; jesus_claims.html:174 fences the same move with an orthonote ('Bracketing John, not doubting it'). (2) INFERENCE TO BEST EXPLANATION, NEVER PROOF. Del Rosario flag 1. Scene 10 says 'only God could claim that' — the claim is about what the words amount to, not a demonstration. Do not upgrade any card to 'proves'. (3) HOSTILE TESTIMONY IS THE ENGINE. The argument runs from the ENEMIES' reaction (scribes in ch.2, high priest in ch.14), which is why it survives 'his followers said so'. Keep scene 9. (4) MARK NEVER WRITES 'JESUS IS GOD' AND THE REEL MUST SAY SO (scene 10). Claiming Mark states it is false and a well-read skeptic closes the whole reel with one verse. (5) CHALCEDON — scene 11 affirms full humanity from Mark's own text (asleep 4:38, hungry 11:12, dead 15:37). This is the standing corpus gap logged in CLAUDE.md; a deity reel without it can leave a functionally monophysite Christ. (6) MARK 2:6 SAYS THE SCRIBES QUESTIONED 'IN THEIR HEARTS' — scene 4 says 'think', not 'say'. (7) NO CLAIM OF SCHOLARLY CONSENSUS that Mark carries a high Christology — Ehrman disputes exactly this, and an unattributed consensus claim is the registry-retired class. The reel asserts what Mark NARRATES and what the characters in it REACT to, which is not contestable. (8) 'The last Gospel written' / 'the earliest Gospel' are the standard datings and jesus_claims.html states Markan priority flatly in its own voice.
